camel_example: aliyun sas DescribeClusterBasicInfo --region cn-hangzhou --Type containerNetwork --ClusterId c870ec78ecbcb41d2a35c679823ef0000 --TargetType Cluster
description_en: Queries cluster information by cluster ID
description_zh: 根据集群编号查询集群信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-cluster-basic-info --cluster-id c870ec78ecbcb41d2a35c679823ef0000 --type containerNetwork --target-type Cluster --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterBasicInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster that you want to query.
You can call the [DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的集群的ID。
您可以调用[DescribeGroupedContainerInstances](~~DescribeGroupedContainerInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
containerNetwork: container network topology switch
interceptionSwitch: cluster microsegmentation switch
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型。取值：
containerNetwork：容器网络拓扑开关
interceptionSwitch：集群微隔离开关
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The operation dimension of the target switch configuration. Valid values:
Cluster: cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
目标开关的配置的操作维度。取值：
Cluster：集群ID
parameters.name: target_type

ClusterType.description_en:
The cluster type. Valid values:

ManagedKubernetes: managed Kubernetes
NotManagedKubernetes: non-managed Kubernetes
PrivateKubernetes: private cluster
kubernetes: dedicated Kubernetes
ask: dedicated ASK
ClusterType.description_zh:
集群类型。取值：

ManagedKubernetes：kubernetes托管版
NotManagedKubernetes：kubernetes非托管版
PrivateKubernetes：私有集群
kubernetes：kubernetes专有版
ask：ask专有版

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the cluster was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建集群时间戳，单位为毫秒

CurrentVersion.description_en: The version information of the cluster

InstanceCount.description_en: The number of instances in the cluster
InstanceCount.description_zh: 当前集群中存在的实例数量

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the cluster

State.description_en:
The availability status. Valid values:

unavailable: Not available.
Available: Available.
Creating: Being created.
CreateFailed: Creation failed
State.description_zh:
是否可用。取值：

unavailable：不可用
Available：可用
Creating：创建中
CreateFailed：创建失败

TargetResult.description_en:
The cluster switch status.

true: enabled
false: disabled
TargetResult.description_zh:
集群开关。

true：开
false：关

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
